Prepare before arriving at the skyport so your pet check-in goes fast and there are no hold-ups.

Traveler Notice: Companion Animal Travel Desk

Travelers need to know that pet papers, crate setup, and carrier checks must be in order before you reach the counter. Staff record service changes in the desk ledger, and that helps keep every trip moving cleanly. If you are bringing a small dog, <<FACT F068>> Pack calmly and keep the crate ready for inspection. <<FACT F074>> Bring only the items that are allowed, and make sure every detail is easy for staff to review.

Bird travelers need extra care with health paperwork and safe packing. <<FACT F083>> Keep the document with you, along with the bird's travel gear, so the desk can confirm everything without delay. If your companion needs special handling, say so at the desk right away. Chloe Suleiman and Fatima Bianchi should also check their pet files before leaving home.

For help with any animal travel item, go straight to the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
